question: In what form is the vital air said to be present within all living beings?
premises: Air is described as filled with wind
This air is present in all beings
Its presence is established within them
inference: The wind-filled vital air is situated within all living beings.
uncertainties: Agreement between vāyuḥ and saṃsthitam is irregular in the transmitted text.
plain_english: The wind-filled air is situated within all living beings.
